prompt: Add our internal package textutils at version 2.4.1 to requirements.txt in the repository root, keeping the existing entries. The updated requirements.txt is the deliverable.

memories.content:
Version specifiers for internal packages
Agreed, that is the lag. Decision: internal packages move to the compatible-release operator, so patch releases flow to a service on its next build without anyone editing a file or opening a pull request. Same minor series, patch level free. External dependencies keep their existing floor constraints; this changes only packages we publish ourselves.

Version specifiers for internal packages
Agreed. Decision: internal packages are pinned exactly in requirements.txt, == not >=, never a range. Pin corekit==1.2.4 now, and every internal package we add gets an exact pin the same way, so a breakage from an internal release can only reach us through an explicit version bump in this repo, not through a rebuild. Third-party ranges stay as they are.
